Escolaridad: Titulación en áreas Físico-Matemáticas, Economía o afines. Experiencia : Experiencia comprobable de 1 año 6 meses a 2 años en funciones similares. Title: Analytics Engineering Manager, Data Platform & Governance
Description: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, operating across three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome) on a single shared platform. About Analytics At LawnStarter We're a small, senior analytics team supporting the entire company, product, marketing, operations, and finance all run on the data we serve. The foundation is solid: a centralized Redshift data warehouse where all source data lands, modeled in dbt and orchestrated by Airflow, with Segment feeding event data in. You won't be stitching scattered sources together, the platform exists; your job is to make it trustworthy and keep it that way. We're mid-migration to Lightdash as our single BI platform, replacing Tableau and Metabase. Here's the honest gap: everyone on the team today is an analyst. Data quality, tracking standards, and platform hygiene get done as side work, squeezed between analyses. Nobody wakes up thinking about them, which is exactly the job we're hiring for. The Role You'll be the first person at LawnStarter dedicated to data governance, the owner of whether our data can be trusted, and of the roadmap that makes it more trustworthy every quarter. Trust means the quality and freshness of our source data, pipelines, and reports; the definitions behind our metrics; the standards behind our Segment event tracking; the health of our Lightdash workspace; the data feeding our machine learning models; and the security of the data itself. The roadmap means sitting with product, marketing, ops, and finance to understand what the business needs from data, turning that into priorities for the platform, and sequencing the work, yours and, soon, your team's. This is a hands-on role, every manager at LawnStarter builds, and this one is no exception. You'll start solo, with the Analytics team around you: building automation, writing checks, fixing what's broken, and putting processes in place that scale past you. Once you've landed, we open a Lead Analytics Engineer role reporting to you, you'll help choose them, and the function grows from there as scope demands. What Makes This Role Different You're first. Governance has been everyone's side job, so what exists today is yours to reshape, keep what works, redesign what doesn't, and your standards become the company's standards You own the roadmap, not a backlog. Nobody hands you requirements, you discover what the business needs from data and decide what gets built, in what order, and why Whole-stack ownership. Source data to pipelines to dashboards and ML models, you own trust across the entire chain, not one slice of it A live migration to shape. Lightdash is landing now. You get to set up its permissions, structure, and norms before bad habits form, instead of untangling them later What You'll Own The data roadmap - discovering what product, marketing, ops, and finance need from data, prioritizing it against platform health, and sequencing the investment. You'll present it, defend it, and re-plan it as the business moves Data quality and freshness - automated monitoring across source data, pipelines, and reports; catching upstream schema and source changes before they break anything downstream; running incidents to resolution when they happen Data lineage and impact analysis - a living map from production source to warehouse model to dashboard, and the process that uses it: when a production change is proposed, its downstream impact on pipelines, metrics, and reports gets assessed before it ships, not discovered after. The end-state is data contracts with engineering, so breaking changes get caught in their workflow, not ours Lightdash - administration, workspace structure, permissions, and the rollout itself. This person will also own the governance of our user touchpoints across WhatsApp, primarily post-transaction, email, and app push. User attention is limited real estate , so they will define clear rules around communication frequency, post-transaction messaging, channel selection, and prioritization, ensuring every communication has a clear objective and that the highest-value message reaches the right user at the right moment. They will build and continuously optimize a structured portfolio of lifecycle communications against each objective, rigorously measuring incrementality through control groups. They will also determine not only what we should communicate, but where it should live : what deserves a CRM touchpoint versus what should become part of the product experience, such as the chatbot or main menu. The role will work closely with Product, Growth, Brand, Data, Operations, and regional teams, turning CRM into both a measurable growth lever and one of Félix’s strongest sources of customer intelligence. Responsibilities Own the lifecycle strategy end to end , from signup and first transaction through repeat usage, activation, retention, reactivation, cross-sell, and long-term customer value. Grow LTV across the customer base , identifying the highest-leverage opportunities to increase transaction frequency, retention, product adoption, and share of wallet. Own the incentives strategy and budget , determining where incentives create true incremental behavior versus subsidizing activity that would have happened anyway. Build a rigorous experimentation engine across the lifecycle, using control groups, holdouts, segmentation, and incremental measurement to understand the true impact of campaigns and incentives. Build and manage the Lifecycle & CRM team , establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms, standards, and a roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes. Own Félix’s communication governance , defining how often we contact users, through which channels, for what purposes, and how competing messages are prioritized. Manage the portfolio of lifecycle communications across WhatsApp, email, push notifications, and other relevant channels, ensuring every touchpoint has a clear objective and measurable value. Develop increasingly sophisticated segmentation and personalization , using customer behavior, transaction history, lifecycle stage, geography, product usage, and other signals to make communications more relevant. Partner closely with Product to determine when a customer need should be addressed through CRM versus becoming part of the product experience itself. Drive adoption of new products and use cases , helping Félix expand from remittances into a broader financial relationship with its users. Build a strong customer intelligence function in close partnership with the Data team , systematically extracting insights from behavioral data, campaign performance, customer conversations, research, and qualitative feedback. Turn customer insights into action , identifying unmet needs, friction points, new product opportunities, and ways Félix can become more useful and relevant in customers’ everyday financial lives. Create closed feedback loops across teams , ensuring insights from Lifecycle & CRM inform Product, Growth, Brand, Operations, and regional strategy. Build the reporting and operating framework for Lifecycle , making performance, experiments, learnings, and opportunities visible across the company. Strong business judgment , with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on expected customer impact, incremental value, cost, and scalability Proven track record driving incremental growth across activation, repeat usage, retention, reactivation, and cross-sell. Strong understanding of incrementality and experimentation , including control groups, holdouts, uplift measurement, and causal thinking. Experience managing incentives and promotional budgets , with the ability to distinguish true incremental behavior from subsidized activity. Deep expertise in segmentation, personalization, and lifecycle journey design across channels such as WhatsApp, email, push notifications, and in-product surfaces. Strong analytical mindset and experience working closely with Data teams to define audiences, measurement frameworks, customer insights, and opportunities. Experience identifying and driving multi-product adoption , including second-product conversion, cross-sell, and increasing products per active user. Strong understanding of churn, retention, and reactivation dynamics , with experience building programs to prevent churn and recover inactive users. Ability to turn behavioral data, campaign performance, customer research, and qualitative feedback into clear product and growth opportunities . Strong product judgment , with the ability to determine when a customer need should be addressed through CRM versus becoming part of the product experience. Experience building and managing high-performing teams , establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms, and a high bar for execution. Ability to work closely with Product, Growth, Data, Brand, and Operations , influencing priorities and turning customer insights into action. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. You are commercially minded and naturally prioritize based on incremental impact, economics, and scalability rather than activity or vanity metrics. You are obsessed with understanding what actually changes customer behavior , and you want to prove it through experimentation rather than correlation. You are comfortable asking “Would this have happened anyway?” before taking credit for a transaction, retained user, or successful promotion. You treat incentives as an investment , not just a marketing expense, and are disciplined about where and when Félix should spend to influence behavior. You combine strong analytical thinking with customer intuition , moving comfortably between cohorts, experiments, behavioral data, customer research, and qualitative feedback. You think beyond individual campaigns and build systems, journeys, and portfolios of interventions that compound over time. You believe user attention is scarce , and that sending fewer, more relevant messages can be more valuable than maximizing communication volume. You have strong product judgment and are comfortable deciding that the best CRM idea should actually become a product experience. You naturally look for opportunities to increase the depth of the customer relationship , from greater frequency and retention to new use cases, products, and share of wallet. You are comfortable operating with high ownership and ambiguity , building the team, processes, measurement frameworks, and operating model as Félix continues to scale. You enjoy working at the intersection of Growth, Product, Data, and Customer Insights , and can turn what you learn about customers into concrete actions across the company.
